# Private conversation debrief

> Duplicate this template into a private working location. Never commit a completed copy.  
> Do not include a participant's name, organization, contact details, transcript, direct quotation, or distinctive identifying facts.  
> Target completion time: five minutes within 24 hours of the conversation.

## Minimal context

**Conversation number:** [1–5 within the current review set]

**Broad audience:** [Individual / Team member / Team leader / Founder / Student or researcher / Other broad group]

**Prior relationship:** [New connection / Existing relationship / Referral]

Avoid exact dates, employers, job titles, locations, or project names unless they are essential in the private working copy. None belong in the aggregate repository summary.

## The question beneath the question

**Stated question, paraphrased:** [One sentence]

**Decision or tension underneath it:** [One sentence]

## Consistent codes

Use the definitions in `docs/playbooks/conversation-learning.md`.

**Primary question code:** [strategy / workflow / tool_selection / evaluation / adoption / risk / meaning]

**Secondary question codes:** [Zero to two codes]

**Constraint codes:** [Select only observed constraints]

**Strongest outcome code:** [reframed / decided / next_experiment / resource_or_referral / no_clear_next_step]

## Three-lens reflection

**Technical:** [What capability, limitation, data, or system fact mattered?]

**Operational:** [What workflow, owner, incentive, or adoption condition mattered?]

**Human:** [What judgment, agency, meaning, trust, or lived consequence mattered?]

## Outcome evidence

**What was clearer or different by the end?** [Observable change, not a compliment]

**Immediate next action:** [Action or “none”]

**Owner:** [Broad role or “unclear”]

**Timing:** [Broad timeframe or “unclear”]

**Value signal:** [Unprompted follow-up / Requested resource / Referral intent / Feedback submitted / No signal yet]

## Learning

**Possible recurring theme:** [Short, generalized phrase]

**What should Matthew repeat?** [One behavior, question, or explanation]

**What should Matthew change?** [One behavior, question, or explanation]

**Potential next artifact:** [Resource / Article / Offer experiment / Process change / None yet]

## Privacy check

- [ ] No direct quotation is included.
- [ ] No name, organization, contact detail, or distinctive fact is included.
- [ ] The note separates observation from interpretation.
- [ ] This completed copy will remain outside the public repository.
